purpose: Wave 1 controlled catalogue. One row per current product, reconciling the public catalogue, the preparation manifest and the 7 September founder decision. Local planning evidence only; not a release record and not proof of a working capability.
vat_treatment: not-currently-vat-registered; review before registration takes effect

products.name: Free Directory
products.capability_gate: Search and profile rendering must match the underlying records; blank rating, Not Rated and not-inspected must render as three distinct states.
products.notes: Claims and corrections are free and sit inside the Directory, subject to existing claim gates. A verified claimant is not a CQC quality endorsement.

products.name: Territory Opportunity Brief
products.capability_gate: Buyer-agreed criteria; every selection sourced; dataset schema and file checks passed; delivery start agreed.
products.notes: Lead launch product. The completed Birmingham/Solihull pack (353 locations, 329 providers, 25 selected organisations) is the prototype and those figures may only be shown in that exact scope. It is a starting point, not proof of buyer fit.

products.name: Market Movement Report
products.capability_gate: Compatible source editions, a reproducible event ledger and one completed checked edition. Availability wording stays conditional until delivery is actually tested.
products.notes: Implementation detail lives in artifacts/sales/2026-09-08-market-movement-report-implementation-plan.md. No bespoke analysis may be promised in the prepared edition.

products.name: Radar founding-buyer pilot (in flight)
products.cta_allowed: none — no new pilot sends without a fresh decision
products.capability_gate: Verify the promised cadence and data route before accepting payment.
products.notes: Four-week offer held open for three recorded contacts on existing terms. Absent from the public catalogue, which is correct. Do not rename it a one-provider or five-provider audit; do not upgrade, discount or alter existing terms as part of visual work.

products.name: Radar Regional
products.capability_gate: Verified ingest and diff history, truthful freshness status, deduplication, delivery checks, regional boundaries, tested limits, access control.
products.conflict: Live Stripe product and price IDs exist for a product the founder decision holds closed, and the manifest carries checkout_enabled: true. See claim-register CONF-1.
products.notes: £299/month exists in the manifest and is not approved for current sale. It must not appear as a price in customer-facing copy.

products.name: Radar National
products.capability_gate: National coverage and history, scope consistency, permissions, promised limits, reliable delivery. A regional sample does not establish any of these.
products.conflict: Same as radar-regional. See claim-register CONF-1.
products.notes: £799/month exists in the manifest and is not approved for current sale.

products.name: Strategic Territory Intelligence Assignment
products.capability_gate: Evidence and history gate, product admission, buyer-specific scope, capacity, method and review.
products.notes: No quote, payment or delivery commitment. No invented investment advice or standard outputs.

products.name: Founding Intelligence Membership
products.capability_gate: Evidence and history gate, explicit service definition, repeatable delivery, sustainable capacity.
products.notes: Frequency and response promises remain undefined and must not be stated.

products.name: Intelligence Feed Pilot
products.capability_gate: Tested API and auth, actual signing and verification, replay and idempotency, cursor stability, rate and usage terms, monitoring, agreed service scope.
products.conflict: Live Stripe IDs exist. See claim-register CONF-1.
products.notes: £6,000/year appears in the manifest and is not validated for sale. Schema examples must be marked illustrative.

products.name: Embedded Enterprise
products.capability_gate: Technical, security and procurement review; tenant boundaries; contractual terms; explicit deployment and support scope.
products.notes: White-label, SLA and support scope appear in copy. That copy is not evidence they exist.

archived.rule: Compatibility and support records only. Do not resurrect, re-price, or alter existing entitlements during polishing.
